title: Brandon's Essential Art Books
content: Thanks to concept artist and illustratorBrandon Daytonfor listing "Color and Light" as one of his top four basic art instruction books. (Link to YouTube)--Brandon's list includes (Amazon links):Figure Drawing, Design and Invention by Michael HamptonHow To Draw by Scott RobertsonDrawing on the Right Side of the Brain by Betty EdwardsColor and Light by James Gurney(orsigned from my site)Honorable Mentions:Design Basics by David A. Lauer and Stephen PentakMemory Drawing, Perceptual Training and Recall by Darren R. RousarStrength Training Anatomy by Frederic Delavier
